source: The Enemy AI doc, "The HSM as JSON" (rev 1736): the spec HsmSpecTest checks the Kotlin machine against. Keep it in step with the doc.

transition_rules.within_a_state: first true rule in listed order

have_visual.note: Today's nose cone; stays on for a tunable few seconds after losing sight

radar_signature.note: Listed as 'radar indicator' among the percepts. Stays on for LOST_TARGET_TICKS (2 s) after contact drops; perception keeps the countdown

have_orders.note: True while the enemy holds an order

order.set_by: Level Conductor; a spawn stand-in for the demo, which re-aims the bearing at the player every few seconds
order.note: Only kind 'heading' for now. Later kinds, such as engaging another target, add fields without changing the trees

under_fire.note: Each near miss the pilot notices adds under_fire_gain; the level decays at a constant rate. Two thresholds, so an enemy keeps evading until it has gone a while without a close shot. Better pilots notice more of the shots

damage_taken.note: Any hull damage, including collisions with rocks and ships. Once on, stays on: morale only breaks one way

near_miss.note: 1 on a tick with a noticed close round, else 0: a near miss, a round that crossed the hit box but failed the hit roll, or a hit

outgunned.note: Climbs from 0 while outnumbered and taking near misses, decays toward 0 otherwise, never leaves 0..1. Feeds morale; not used by any transition yet

lost_pursuer.note: Turns on once a fleeing enemy has left the player's camera view as currently framed (zoom included), and stays on so a Final Stand enemy isn't sent back to Fleeing

morale_type.note: How much the pilot feels it can take on; rules read it like any other percept

params_note: under_fire_gain and under_fire_decay_per_second are starting values for every NPC through step 4; both stay tunable, later per NPC type and difficulty

states.note: Enemies pick targets as the player does, so one can be chasing and under fire at once

transitions.note: Smarter NPCs might try attacking instead
